name: Open Ground
text: Nothing to hide behind and nothing in the way.

name: Rubble
text: Slow to cross, but it stops a lot of what is aimed at you.

name: Scrap Heap
text: The best cover on the field. Wading into it is a commitment.

name: Slag Pool
text: Crossable, and it cooks you the whole way. Brawlers seize in here.

name: Ridge
text: High ground. Everything you carry reaches further from up here.
